{{Infobox league |name=QWSL Draft |image=Qwsl-logo_draft.png |series= |organizer={{player|Hooraytio|flag=se}} {{player|Link|flag=no}} {{player|Doomie|flag=pl}} |sponsor= |type=Online |format=4on4 |prizepool= |sdate=2026.03.30 |edate=2026.05.10 |year=2026 |website= |discord=discord.gg/EaDUYqRDGM |twitch= |teamfirst= |teamfirstflag= |teamsecond= |teamsecondflag= |teamthird= |teamthirdflag= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |team_number= |map1=rocka |map2=steam |map3=obsidian |map4=anwalked |map5=stronghold |map6=qobblestone |map7=defer }} {{Tabs static |name1=Overview |link1=QWSL Draft |name2=Rules |link2=QWSL Draft/rules |name3=Players |link3=QWSL Draft/players |name4=Standings |link4=QWSL Draft/standings |This=1 }} The '''QWSL Draft''' is a [[4on4]] tournament for everyone who wants to play custom maps. It it will start asap after [[QWSL_DIV2|QWSL DIV2]] is done. Signup will be broadcasted on discord when it is ready. '''UPDATE 25.03.2026: Tour started!''' == Format == - 8 teams
- 7 groupgames of Go3
- Playoff quarterfinals: 1v8-2v7-3v6-4v5
- Playoff A and B: loser of QF to B. Semis/Bronze/Final.
- All teams 7 games of Go3 and 3 games of Bo5
== Game Procedure == Because it is 7 maps in the pool, the games will be played with the following map procedure: '''toss toss pick pick toss toss play''' Bo5 playoff: '''toss toss pick pick pick pick play''' == Timeframe == We aim to start at the end of March and the tournament should take 8-9 weeks, ending the tournament 2nd week of May. == Draft == '''[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pdkKBFLf3JvFjK2zqp_CvBwyYCZgQFG5aijxlCIx5Fs/edit?gid=0#gid=0 HERE]''' == Maps == {{Maps |title= |map1=rocka |map2=steam |map3=obsidian |map4=anwalked |map5=stronghold |map6=qobblestone |map7=defer }} __NOTOC__
